answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent verified work, so influence is always today's earning, never a permanent grant. An identity that falls to a whisper slides toward zero. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones, ferrous and waiting, and wake them for a vote — each must do real graded work every epoch to keep its weight, so an idle swarm rots like untended timber while only the active agent holds its height.
